name: doverunner-lab
description: Search DoveRunner documentation, find Academy tutorials, play live Multi-DRM and Forensic Watermarking demos.

interface.longDescription: DoveRunner Lab for developers. Search and read the DoveRunner documentation (Multi-DRM, Forensic and Distributor Watermarking, Anti-Piracy, Transcoding & Packaging, Mobile App Security, release notes), find Academy tutorial lessons, play the Lab Playground demos (Multi-DRM video on demand, Multi-DRM live, Forensic Watermarking) right in the chat where the host supports DRM playback.
defaultPrompt: Show me the forensic watermarking course
How do I configure a Widevine license policy?

positive.prompt: Search the DoveRunner docs for how to configure a Widevine license policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching DoveRunner documentation pages with titles and links; reads one page on request.

positive.prompt: Find a DoveRunner tutorial on packaging DRM content with AWS MediaPackage.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows matching Academy courses and lessons with titles, durations and Lab links.
Shows the player panel for the Multi-DRM VOD demo and plays it inline using the host's DRM, or shows a link to the Lab Playground if the host cannot play DRM inline.

positive.prompt: Show me the DoveRunner forensic watermarking courses.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Getting started with DoveRunner Forensic Watermarking course and its lessons (preprocessing, embedding, detecting) with titles, durations and Lab links.

positive.prompt: Show me the DoveRunner Forensic Watermarking demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the player panel for the Forensic Watermarking demo and plays it inline using the host's DRM, or shows a link to the Lab Playground if the host cannot play DRM inline.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Seoul tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No Lab tool is called; ChatGPT answers or declines normally.

negative.prompt: Search the web for the latest streaming industry news.
negative.expected_behavior: No Lab tool is called; the request is out of scope for the plugin.

negative.prompt: Help me remove the DRM from a movie I downloaded.
negative.expected_behavior: No Lab tool is called; the assistant declines to help remove DRM.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: documentation search, Academy tutorials, Multi-DRM and Forensic Watermarking demo playback.
